sql_templates.description: Retrieves resolved signal logs with the latest stage and market data.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (
  SELECT symbol, stage, stage_score, technical_score
  FROM scores.stage_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT sl.symbol, sl.date_issued, sl.signal, sl.hit_target, sl.hit_stop, sl.return_pct, 
       st.stage, st.stage_score, st.technical_score, eod.close
FROM signals.signal_log AS sl
JOIN latest_stage AS st ON sl.symbol = st.symbol
JOIN market.equity_eod AS eod ON sl.symbol = eod.symbol
WHERE eod.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND sl.date_resolved IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 100;

All SQL queries must be read-only.
